repo_notes.content: Use docs/specs/*.md as implementation-backed feature specifications, docs/development.md as the architecture and validation reference, and AGENTS.md as the maintenance and placement guidance. Treat source code and tests as the final source of truth when documentation disagrees.

Do not treat generated output directories as architecture sources: app/runtime-dist/, app/renderer-dist/, and app/native-dist/ are build artifacts. Focus on app/main.ts, app/main-process/, app/browser/, app/webview-preload.ts, app/renderer-src/, app/data/, app/download/, native/local-data-engine/, native/download-engine/, test/, and docs/specs/.

Document stable ownership boundaries and behavior contracts. Avoid presenting volatile implementation details such as exact helper names, queue internals, or concurrency numbers as long-term product facts unless they are confirmed in source code or docs/specs/.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to Jable Desktop, its Electron desktop app, major runtime layers, and where to find authoritative docs.

pages.title: Development and Release Workflow
pages.purpose: Developer setup, Node 24 requirement, Rust native addon builds, main npm scripts, test selection, packaging, release workflow, and validation guidance from docs/development.md and docs/specs/testing-validation.md.

pages.title: Desktop Architecture
pages.purpose: Renderer, Electron main process, webview preload, shared browser policy modules, Rust native engines, and how IPC connects these boundaries.

pages.title: Electron Main Process
pages.purpose: Main process composition, IPC handler registration, settings persistence, app actions, window lifecycle, browser runtime wiring, and update checks.

pages.title: Browser Runtime
pages.purpose: Embedded WebContentsView tabs, session partitioning, tab policy, fallback Jable origins, URL trust rules, context menus, shortcuts, fullscreen, and browser session restore.

pages.title: Renderer UI
pages.purpose: Vue renderer structure, App.vue responsibilities, BrowserPanel, LibraryPanel, SettingsPanel, reusable components, composables, state ownership, and window.jableApp usage.

pages.title: Webview Preload and Sync
pages.purpose: Injected Jable page runtime, scraping, pager handling, quick/full sync, AJAX fallback, deferred collection actions, pending remote operation overlays, and sync worker interaction.

pages.title: Local Data Engine
pages.purpose: Rust SQLite data engine, schema and migrations, collections, FTS search, URL canonicalization, list/count contracts, JSON import/export, and Node/Rust test responsibilities.

pages.title: Sync and Outbox Semantics
pages.purpose: Quick sync, full sync, visibility reconciliation, deferred remote operations, outbox states, pending remote groups, automatic replay, manual Add/Remove/Resolved actions, and behavior guarantees from docs/specs/data-sync.md.

pages.title: Download System
pages.purpose: Download manager architecture, TypeScript orchestration modules, Rust HLS download engine, FFmpeg remuxing, playback-triggered capture, local playback, file actions, and shutdown behavior.

pages.title: IPC Contract
pages.purpose: Renderer-to-main preload bridge, IPC payload types, normalization and validation rules, channel alignment requirements, preload event flow, and tests guarding the boundary.

pages.title: Internationalization
pages.purpose: Desktop locale dictionaries, supported locales, locale selection and IPC propagation, key parity tests, and user-facing copy rules.

pages.title: Testing Guide
pages.purpose: Node tests, renderer Vitest tests, Rust tests, Electron Playwright smoke tests, format/lint/typecheck/build gates, and how to choose focused validation for a change.

pages.title: Maintenance Guidelines
pages.purpose: Architecture placement rules, no-spec-change refactor workflow, current refactor backlog/watchlist, generated output rules, documentation update rules, and anti-over-engineering guidance.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of project-specific terms such as quick sync, full sync, Pending Sync, outbox, site_order, WebContentsView tab, fallback origin, playback capture, and native engines.
